appDescription: Car assistant that answers calls while driving and keeps call summaries and the next schedule.

function.name: READ_RECENT_CALLS
function.description: Reads aloud the summary of recent calls the assistant answered.

function.name: READ_NEXT_SCHEDULE
function.description: Reads aloud the time and place of the next schedule.

function.name: ADD_REST_STOP
function.description: Adds the nearest rest stop with a restroom to the current route.
